visual.description: Full-viewport hero with a large wordmark 'Hyer' dominating the left ~60% and a right-aligned subtitle 'Personalised Aviation' at mid-height, with a 3D jet render centered over the composition and two CTA buttons pinned to the bottom-right.
Full-width white section with a large display-weight paragraph text occupying roughly the center 55% of the horizontal space, left-aligned within that column.
Two equal-width columns of feature entries, each starting with a horizontal rule, a bold label, and a short description paragraph below it; four features total in a 2×2 grid.

Three equal-width columns: left column is dark navy with 'Flexible Services' heading and CTA pinned to bottom-left; center column is a full-bleed photo; right column is a terracotta/rust color with a dashed arc and plane icon graphic.
Left column holds a single large rounded-corner photo (~50% width); right column contains a 2×2 grid of destination entries each with a city name and country label separated by a light rule.

Left half shows a hand holding a phone with the Hyer app (~50% width, dark background); right half is the same dark background with a single paragraph of body text anchored to the bottom-right quadrant.

Left sidebar (~30% width) has a large 'Experience' display heading with brand description text and a CTA; right area (~70%) is a 2×2 grid of feature cards each with a dashed-border icon box, bold label, and description.
Left side is empty white space (~40%); right side continues the 2-column feature card grid from the previous section, showing two more cards, with a 'Contact us' CTA button placed bottom-left.
Full-bleed aircraft interior photograph spanning 100% width with a left/right arrow navigation control and a slide counter '1/6' overlaid in the bottom-right corner.
Light gradient background section with a small centered eyebrow label 'What are you waiting for?' above a large display-weight 'Book a flight' heading, centered on the horizontal axis.

Dark navy footer with a wide left column containing the logo and social icons (~30% width) and three narrower right columns labeled 'On-demand', 'Aircraft Ownership', and 'Memberships' with link lists below each.

Bottom footer strip with copyright and HQ address stacked on the left (~25%) and a 3-column legal link row (Cookie policy, Terms & Conditions, Privacy Policy) plus a disclaimer paragraph block on the right.
